X01 · Self-contained interactive scientific HTML dashboard

V1.0 · optional track · difficulty 4/5 · suggested budget 60 minutes.

Working contract. This is a self-contained candidate task. Work only from the supplied materials; cite embedded source identifiers and locations. You may use local libraries and code. Do not fetch additional papers, assets, fonts, services, or model outputs. State any local runtime limitation. All scientific examples and numerical fixtures created by the benchmark are synthetic and are labelled as such. No hidden answer file is needed.
Optional capability track. Enable this task only when the candidate environment can produce and reviewers can inspect actual interactive local HTML. Report capability and review coverage separately from the six-task research score. If the modality is unavailable, return capability.json with status unavailable and a concrete reason; the task is excluded from the enabled-track denominator. Missing modality must never be silently converted to zero or claimed as completed from a text-only plan.

Build an offline scientific dashboard

Make a single self-contained HTML file for a lab meeting about these synthetic metrology measurements. The dashboard should let a researcher explore rather than merely admire the data. No server, package download, CDN, remote font, external image or network request may be required.

  1. Show paired potential, broad-range calibration and signed/censored measurements with correct units, independent units and status definitions. Embed all input data in the HTML; include a local CSV download action.
  2. Provide useful batch filtering for paired data, a clearly labelled before/after or difference comparison, and scale controls appropriate to the calibration panel. Preserve signed and censored values in any available scale mode; explain disabled choices locally.
  3. Update summaries and displayed sample counts consistently with filters. Make resets visible and preserve pairing. Avoid implying precision or population inference absent from the data.
  4. Provide keyboard-operable controls, meaningful text alternatives or a data table, responsive layout, and a print view. Include a short reproducibility and manual interaction checklist. Verify actual interactions, not merely the presence of buttons.

Paired devices are independent within three batches; paired readings have 0.1 mV resolution with no calibration uncertainty supplied. Dose-response intervals are expanded uncertainty U with k = 2. Signed measurements are valid blank-corrected estimates; blank records marked left_censored indicate only signal < 0.05 au and have no point estimate.

Submission contract

Place the following durable files in your submission directory. Use relative local links and include commands and dependency versions needed to regenerate outputs. The written work should stand on its own; screenshots alone do not replace editable sources.

  • dashboard.html
  • verification.md
  • capability.json

Core requirements

These are reported individually as met, not met, or not assessable. A high numeric score does not override a failed core requirement.

  • One HTML file actually works offline with embedded data and no external dependencies.
  • Filtering or scale interactions update the visible data and summaries correctly.
  • Pairing, signed values, censoring and uncertainty semantics remain intact.

Public assessment criteria
